Abraham
person
CHARACTER DISCOVERY
Abraham
Call · land · household · covenant · sons · testing · burial · memory
Abram becomes Abraham while country, land, altars, wealth, kin, kings, covenant, household conflict, sons, testing, grief, property, inheritance, death, and later memory gather around the same person.
Enter the trail
Open Character World
FIRST GLANCE
A life in eight movements
I
Origins and call
3 scenes
Abram enters through a family line, leaves Haran, crosses Canaan, builds altars, and goes down to Egypt under famine.
II
Land and neighbors
4 scenes
Land, wealth, kinship, conflict, separation, rescue, and encounters with kings gather around Abram.
III
Promise and household
5 scenes
Promise is spoken beside childlessness, Hagar and Ishmael enter the household story, and Abram receives a new name and covenant sign.
IV
Hospitality and intercession
4 scenes
Abraham receives visitors, hears renewed speech about Sarah, presses questions about Sodom, and moves through its aftermath and Gerar.
V
Sons and testing
5 scenes
Isaac is born, Hagar and Ishmael depart, a treaty is made, and Abraham is tested with the son named in the promise.
VI
Loss and final years
7 scenes
Sarah dies, Abraham obtains burial ground, Rebekah joins Isaac, inheritance is ordered, and Abraham dies and is buried.
VII
Family and Israel remember
18 scenes
Isaac, Jacob, Torah, histories, prayer, poetry, prophets, and later Jewish writings remember Abraham through oath, ancestry, friendship, and promise.
VIII
Gospel and apostolic memory
25 scenes
Genealogies, speeches, parables, disputes, and letters invoke Abraham in distinct arguments about ancestry, promise, faith, action, and hope.
